category_status.title: Intermittent Login Failures for claude.ai
category_status.description:
Zscaler has detected an issue with its zscaler.net, zscloud.net Cloud. Customers with an HTTP/2 Header Profile applied via a URL Control Policy may experience intermittent login failures when accessing claude.ai. The HTTP/2 profile disrupts the authentication flow, which may prevent login from completing successfully. All other traffic forwarding and policy enforcement remain unaffected.

We will continue to provide updates here as the investigation progresses. For detailed updates, please check the Service Status section in your Zscaler customer support portal (CSP). Status changes and additional details will be posted there as they become available.

Latest Update - Wed, 12 Aug 2026 06:54:30 UTC

The fix developed by Zscaler is currently undergoing validation. A corrected build has been prepared and is proceeding through the testing and validation pipeline. Once validation is successfully completed, the fix will be submitted for production deployment. Existing interim mitigations continue to remain active during this period. The next update will be provided when deployment timelines are confirmed.

Update - Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:39:38 UTC

We have identified the root cause of the issue and are currently assessing mitigation options and next steps.

Update - Mon, 10 Aug 2026 17:20:15 UTC

We have identified the issue as a software-related regression affecting login access to claude.ai in certain environments. Our engineering team is actively working on a permanent fix, and interim mitigation measures remain in place while that work is underway. We are coordinating across teams and will provide further updates as we have more information on the fix timeline and deployment plan.

issues.title: URL Category Classification Issue
issues.short_description: Zscaler has detected an issue with its zscaler.net Cloud. We will continue to provide updates here as the investigation progresses. For detailed updates, please check the Service Status section in ...
issues.description:
Zscaler has detected an issue with its zscaler.net Cloud. We will continue to provide updates here as the investigation progresses. For detailed updates, please check the Service Status section in your Zscaler customer support portal (CSP). Status changes and additional details will be posted there as they become available.

Root Cause: This issue occurred due to a recent service update to the AI/ML content categorization model.

Latest Update - Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:37:00 UTC

Zscaler has confirmed that the recent changes observed in URL categorization behavior are the result of a planned enhancement to our AI/ML content categorization model. This is an expected and intentional improvement, not an issue. The updated model delivers improved detection accuracy and broader coverage, enabling more precise classification of URLs that would previously remain under Miscellaneous or Unknown categories. This change only affects customers who have the AI/ML-based content categorization feature enabled. Customers who prefer to retain their existing URL categorization behavior may temporarily disable the Dynamic Content Categorization feature toggle via the admin portal. For detailed updates, please refer to the Service Status section in your Zscaler Customer Support Portal (CSP), where status changes and additional information will be posted as they become available. This incident is now marked as resolved.

Update - Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:35:32 UTC

Zscaler is prioritizing the issue and is actively working to isolate the problem and identify the root cause. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this investigation. Additional updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
